title: Finite Tate tensor generators and root-normalized site comparison predicates
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $n\geq0$, and put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Write $L_T=\varprojlim_{s\geq1}\mu_{\ell^s,T}^{\mathrm{pro}}$, with its specified root projections $p_s$, using [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf] and [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Define $P_T(k)$, for $k\geq0$, to be the already prescribed finite pro-etale twist $A_T(k)$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], restricted to the fixed constant $A$-module encoding. Its pure tensor generator $g_{T,k}(a;x_1,\ldots,x_k)$ is the image under the recorded coefficient extension and sheafification units of the ordered tensor of root-limit sections, with scalar $a$ in the first factor; for $k=0$ it is the constant scalar-unit section $a$, and for $k+1\geq2$ it is $g_{T,k}(a;x_1,\ldots,x_k)\otimes g_{T,1}(1;x_{k+1})$.
For any commutative coefficient ring $B$ and integer $m\geq0$ with $mB=0$, define $e_{T,k}(b;z_1,\ldots,z_k)$ in the existing etale twist $B_T(k)$ of [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist] by its sheafification-unit pure root tensor, with the same scalar placement and recursion, including the constant scalar unit for $k=0$. Denote by $v^{\mathrm{et}}_m(z)$ the underlying unit in $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times$ of an etale root section, and by $v^{\mathrm{pro}}_s(x)$ the underlying unit of $p_s(x)$.
Use the site comparison $\nu_T$ of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For $r\geq0$ with $\ell^{r+1}A=0$, put $m=\ell^{r+1}$. Define the following predicates, without asserting the existence of any comparison:
(1) An isomorphism $b:\nu_T^*A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(k)\to P_T(k)$ is root-normalized if for every etale $U/T$, pro-etale $W/T$, map $f:W\to U$ over $T$, scalar $a\in A$ and tuples of etale roots $z_i$ on $U$ and root-limit sections $x_i$ on $W$ satisfying $v^{\mathrm{pro}}_{r+1}(x_i)=f^*v^{\mathrm{et}}_m(z_i)$, its value on the restriction to $W$ of the comparison-adjunction unit applied to $e_{T,k}(a;z_i)$ is $g_{T,k}(a;x_i)$.
(2) For a scheme map $v:T'\to T$, an etale pullback isomorphism $c:v_{\mathrm{et}}^*A_T^{\mathrm{et}}(k)\to A_{T'}^{\mathrm{et}}(k)$ is root-normalized if its adjunct sends $e_{T,k}(a;z_i)$ to $e_{T',k}(a;z'_i)$ on $T'\times_T U$ whenever the underlying units $z'_i$ are the pullbacks of the units $z_i$.
(3) A pro-etale pullback isomorphism $d:v_{\mathrm{pro}}^*P_T(k)\to P_{T'}(k)$ is root-normalized if its adjunct sends $g_{T,k}(a;x_i)$ to $g_{T',k}(a;x'_i)$ on $T'\times_T U$ whenever the underlying units of every root projection of $x'_i$ are the pullbacks of those of $x_i$.
(4) For $r,r'\geq0$ with both $\ell^{r+1}A=0$ and $\ell^{r'+1}A=0$, an etale exponent-change isomorphism $t:A_T^{\mathrm{et},\ell^{r'+1}}(k)\to A_T^{\mathrm{et},\ell^{r+1}}(k)$ is root-normalized if it sends $e_{T,k}(a;z'_i)$ to $e_{T,k}(a;z_i)$ whenever $v^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^{r+1}}(z_i)=v^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^{r'+1}}(z'_i)^{\ell^{r'-r}}$ for every $i$, with natural-number subtraction in the exponent. The intended transitions use $r\leq r'$; the predicate itself is defined for every pair. No invertibility, flatness, or ramification-divisibility condition is imposed merely to define these objects and predicates.

def IsFiniteTateSiteComparison (r : ℕ)
    (hA : ((l ^ (r + 1) : ℕ) : finiteTateCoefficient l E n) = 0) (k : ℕ)
    (b : (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (finiteTateCoefficient l E n)) T).obj
        (finiteEtaleTateTwist T (l ^ (r + 1)) _ hA k) ≅ finiteTateProSheaf l E n T k) : Prop
